text:
claire_fin: NewGen sent a dispute TKT-3344. Sales promised a trial credit code TRIAL2026 that wasn't applied to invoice 83499. They want a $2,500 manual credit + corrected invoice.

devon_sales: argh, we noted the promo in the SF deal but didn't push token to billing. Confirmed it was trial covering reserved for month 1.

pat_billing: need invoice snippet & SKU to create credit memo.

claire_fin: invoice excerpt:
```
Invoice 83499
- Reserved seat pool (NG-RESV): $2,500
- Usage: $320
- Discounts: $0 (expected TRIAL2026)
Total: $2,820
```

pat_billing: OK expected credit = $2,500. GL = 5115 (Promotions). routing for approval.

cfo_linda: approved one-time credit of $2,500 to preserve trial conversion. Note: reason "TRIAL2026 not applied; TKT-3344".

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-0201 created for $2,500. Reissued invoice 83499-R1 (net due $320). Link: https://billing.internal/reports/invoice/83499-R1

pat_billing: emailed CM + reissued invoice to customer and copied sales. added action: require promo token in billing webhook 48h before cutoff.

claire_fin: thanks all. added a quick note to pricing experiments board so engineering exposes promo flags earlier.
